meta.title: Harness OS · Boot Sequence
meta.description: A theme-aware Harness OS boot sequence with an animated DeepSeek whale and DEEPSEEK DSH logo intro that docks in the corner, spoken access prompts, typewriter headlines, a real machine profile (computer name, user, time, IP), a zero-to-full circular radar with a radar-progress-synced needle, glitch scene transitions, a Chinese-then-English welcome voice, synthesized loading audio, button-only interaction, and tray-restore replay.
